calendars.containment: half-open; both entry and exit contained

definitions.constant_long: same accepted primary parents fixed LONG
definitions.constant_short: same accepted primary parents fixed SHORT
definitions.count_net_side: independent rebuild using sign(Issue row count minus Redeem row count) in each exact bucket
definitions.deterministic_random_side: SHA256 UTF-8(source_identity|TUSI-168|RANDOM_SIDE); first byte <128 LONG else SHORT
definitions.exact_direction_flip: same accepted primary parents with every side reversed
definitions.include_destroyed_black_funds: independent rebuild adding DestroyedBlackFunds.amount_raw as negative supply contamination diagnostic
definitions.issue_only: independent rebuild using only Issue; always LONG
definitions.one_bar_delayed_entry: same accepted primary parents; entry_time and exit_time both shifted exactly +300 seconds
definitions.redeem_only: independent rebuild using only Redeem; always SHORT

controls.independent_rebuild_rule: construct own exact causal buckets, sort own raw candidates, and run own global nonoverlap scheduler

one_bar_delayed_projection.each_diagnostic_and_economic_projection: recheck both shifted timestamps against its own half-open period
one_bar_delayed_projection.shifted_boundary_crosser_action: drop before any market or funding lookup

calendar_month_clustered_sign_flip.cluster_value: accumulate Python float net return on allocated equity
calendar_month_clustered_sign_flip.ordered_vector: NumPy float64 in ascending YYYY-MM order

same_primary_parent_complete_qualificati.definition: passes all five standalone gates under both base and stress in every standalone period opened before stop
same_primary_parent_complete_qualificati.one_bar_delayed_entry: timing sensitivity diagnostic only; cannot replace or select primary

period_metrics.mean_gross_underlying_bp: arithmetic mean of side*(exit_open/entry_open-1)*10000 over contained trades

strict_mdd_bar_order: mark pre-cost equity at bar open against the global HWM
execute scheduled exits at that open and charge exit cost; then execute entries and charge entry cost
apply realized funding credits and debits whose timestamp equals the bar
update HWM with max(pre-cost open equity, post-entry-cost equity plus funding credits plus favorable long-high or short-low excursion)
update trough from pre-cost open-equity baseline, subtracting aggregate entry and exit costs once, with funding credits/debits, adverse excursion, and hypothetical liquidation cost at adverse mark

strict_mdd_formulas.excursion_quantity: net signed quantity after that bar exits and entries
strict_mdd_formulas.lower_t: min(E_pre, E_pre - C_in - C_out + F_plus + F_minus + A_minus - Q * P_bad * cost_rate)

standalone_accounting.strict_mdd_hwm_scope: global full-calendar including idle pre-entry time and every earlier sleeve or trade; no per-trade reset

scheduler.diagnostic_boundary_crossing_selection_t: retained in selection reservation clock; skipped from diagnostic; never truncated or replaced
steps: build every raw candidate from complete eligible source
assign to exactly one disjoint main window in order selection,future25,future26 only when both entry and exit are contained; discard main-boundary crossers
sort union by frozen raw-candidate order and run one global nonoverlap reservation
define full accepted clock as accepted union
derive diagnostics and economic periods only by entry-and-exit-contained projection

feature_and_signal.candidate_entry_open: ceil_to_5m(available_at_utc)+5 elapsed minutes; aligned availability still waits 5 minutes

source_identity.serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON; sorted object keys; separators (',',':'); ASCII escaping; finite values; no newline

circularity_boundary.preregistration_binds: two decisions, producer/test, ESDI preregistration and metric authority, complete Gross9 closure and environment
circularity_boundary.replay_claim_binds: preregistration artifact plus every source, support, novelty, economics, imported helper, and test blob

downstream_artifact_contracts.json_serialization: sorted-key two-space-indented ASCII JSON plus one LF; internal manifest_hash is SHA-256 compact sorted-key JSON excluding that field

source_support_report_json_schema.future_append: prefix rule, total difference count, then frozen-control-order raw/accepted row counts and SHA-256 pairs

field_contract.bucket_amount_raw: canonical base-10 signed amount or count integer
field_contract.constituent_identities_json: exact compact JSON used for source identity
field_contract.control: primary or one frozen control string

future_append_views.representation: report objects, not a third CSV schema

expected_post_preregistration_protocol.required_later_binding: each future module and test binds this TUSI preregistration artifact file SHA-256 and manifest_hash as constants
expected_post_preregistration_protocol.separate_source_replay_claim: created and committed after all eight paths are committed; seals their Git blobs and SHA-256 before replay

serialization.manifest_hash: SHA256 compact sorted-key JSON excluding manifest_hash

clock_reconstruction.stage: after ESDI source-support pass and before ESDI economics

fresh_kimchi_fx.side: AUTO from exact exclusive long/short gates

gross9.ranking: maximum minimum base/stress improvement across both periods; tie lower weight
gross9.treatment: scale every Gross9 sleeve by (9-w)/9; add TUSI at w

novelty.below_minimum: reported not gated; never silently discarded

metric_contract.bidirectional_containment: maximum of both directional fractions with inclusive distance at most the frozen window
metric_contract.entries: unique strictly increasing integer UTC seconds after both clocks use the identical half-open common domain
metric_contract.occupied_bar_jaccard: Jaccard of indexes having nonzero signed exposure
metric_contract.signed_exposure: exact {-1,0,1} on each 300-second bar open from sorted contained nonoverlapping [entry,exit) intervals

novelty.pearson_gate: absolute signed-exposure Pearson, implemented as exact squared Pearson with inclusive rational threshold

source.availability: canonical timestamp of event block N+64

pairing.Issue: exactly one same-transaction same-block same-amount Transfer(zero,actor_address,amount)
pairing.Redeem: exactly one same-transaction same-block same-amount Transfer(actor_address,zero,amount)

pre_replay_evidence_boundary.prior_precutoff_rpc: twelve metadata-only boundary and immediately preceding block-header calls

strict_sequence: source_axis_and_mechanism_decisions plus preregistration producer and tests committed and pushed
future builder evaluators and tests implemented committed and pushed with preregistration artifact SHA-256 and manifest_hash bound as constants

separate source-replay claim created committed and pushed, sealing all future protocol Git blobs and SHA-256 before the first precutoff event/log/receipt replay RPC and before source incidence; prior metadata-only boundary headers acknowledged

full_accepted_entry_gap.entries: accepted primary entries contained in full
full_accepted_entry_gap.sort: strictly increasing entry_time integer UTC seconds

compared_views: every raw candidate assigned to selection
future_append_invariance.same_primary_parent_controls: regenerated and compared from prefix/full accepted primary views

utc_entry_month_share.denominator: all accepted primary entries in that period
utc_entry_month_share.numerator: maximum count sharing the same UTC entry_time calendar month
